head: Rn-222
notes: Released-gas group (role released_gas, flow_only): use instead of the Rn-222 tail of Ra226+ when radon escapes to air (METHODS 5.2, fraction epsilon). Ends at Pb-210 (which then belongs to Pb210+, Liberated tier). Not part of the series total. Nominal multiplier 5. Progeny half-lives (3.1 min, 26.8 min, 19.9 min) are all <1/10 of Rn-222 (3.82 d), so the group passes the equilibrium rule (transient factor +0.49%, not applied). Secular-equilibrium convention: member weights are branching-propagated decays per head decay (no transient-equilibrium factor).

head: Rn-220
notes: Released-gas group (role released_gas, flow_only): use instead of the Rn-220 tail of Th228+ when thoron escapes. Ends at stable Pb-208. Not part of the series total. Nominal multiplier 5. Po-212 64.06% / Tl-208 35.94%. COUNTING CONVENTION ONLY: Pb-212 (10.6 h) and Bi-212 (1.0 h) outlive Rn-220 (55.6 s), so the group is not in transient equilibrium and fails the 1/10 half-life rule; the weights are the eventual decays per Rn-220 atom released (flow basis), not a standing-activity ratio. Secular-equilibrium convention: member weights are branching-propagated decays per head decay (no transient-equilibrium factor).

notes: Pr-144 weight = 0.99023 (direct) + 0.0097699 x 0.9993 (via Pr-144m, 7.2 min, IT to Pr-144; ICRP-107) = 0.99999, so every Ce-144 decay is followed by one Pr-144 decay. head: Zr-93
notes: Transient-equilibrium convention: daughter weight = branching x lambda_d/(lambda_d - lambda_h), propagated along the chain. Added by D35. head: Nb-94
